rule:
# NeOS: allow Xorg VESA startup on an unbound VMware VGA adapter.
SUBSYSTEM=="pci", KERNEL=="0000:00:02.0", ATTR{vendor}=="0x15ad", ATTR{class}=="0x030000", DRIVER=="", TAG+="seat", TAG+="master-of-seat"
